WITH group_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    ordervault,
    COUNT(*) as group_count
  FROM riskandmargin
  GROUP BY ordervault
),
total_sum AS (
  SELECT SUM(group_count) as total_count
  FROM group_counts
  WHERE ordervault IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  g.ordervault,
  g.group_count,
  CASE 
    WHEN t.total_count IS NULL OR t.total_count = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(g.group_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_count
  END as quotient
FROM group_counts g
CROSS JOIN total_sum t
WHERE g.ordervault IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CASE WHEN quotient IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, quotient DESC
LIMIT 10
